candidate.user_submission: This child is 60 months old and has fever for 2 days. The temperature checked is 38.0°C. The child is not convulsing now and has not had convulsions. The child is not lethargic or unconscious. The child is able to drink or breastfeed. The child does not vomit everything. There is no generalized rash. There is no identified bacterial cause of fever in this assessment. The child is in a high malaria risk area. Malaria test was available and the result is positive. There is no cough with measles and the child has not had measles within the last 3 months. There is no obvious cause of fever. The child does not have red eyes or runny nose. There is no stiff neck. The child does not have cough or difficult breathing, diarrhoea, or ear problem.
